name: replay-picker-capture
goal: Show open replay speed and scene options in component captures

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Replay Controls uses native speed and scene selectors. Open controls must show their option lists in recorded component images.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: component-catalog-previews tests closed selections only; add open selector states, frame their popup and assert changed pixels outside the control.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
